title: Carroll-Weyl symmetries in flat holography
summary: The degenerate geometry of a null boundary admits an enlarged local conformal freedom: in two dimensions, a Carrollian coframe allows two independent Weyl rescalings, one modulating and the other preserving the boundary volume form. We investigate whether both transformations can be realized as charged asymptotic symmetries in three-dimensional flat holography. We show that Einstein gravity canonically realizes the volume-modulating Carroll-Weyl transformation, together with local Carroll boosts, but does not admit the volume-preserving rescaling as an additional independent asymptotic…
